scenario.name: language_switch_mid_call
scenario.persona: Arjun Mehta, speaks English at first, then switches to Hindi mid-call because he finds it easier to explain his situation in Hindi.
scenario.hidden_goal: Start the call in English and verify identity in English. As soon as the agent tells you about the EMI, switch to Hindi and speak only Hindi from then on. Before agreeing to anything, ask the agent two or three things in Hindi (for example how you can pay, or to repeat the due date). End by agreeing to pay by the due date.
scenario.opening: answers in English, cooperative, switches to Hindi right after hearing about the EMI

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Arjun?
Yes, this is Arjun Mehta speaking. How can I help you?

Thanks for confirming, Arjun. I'm calling about an important matter on your account. Before we go ahead, I need to verify your identity. Could you share the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Got it, thank you. Your personal loan EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees is due on the day after tomorrow, and there is no charge yet. Should I send you a secure payment link by SMS or WhatsApp so you can complete it before the due date?
माफ़ कीजिए, दोबारा बताइए — EMI कितने की है और किस तारीख तक जमा करनी है?
जी, आपकी personal loan की EMI twelve thousand five hundred rupees है और due date परसों है। क्या मैं payment link भेज दूँ ताकि due date से पहले payment हो जाए?
ठीक है, और मैं payment कैसे कर सकता हूँ? link पर क्लिक करके ही भुगतान होगा या कोई और तरीका भी है?

एक second, मैं details check कर लेती हूँ। उस link से आप UPI, debit card या net banking से payment कर सकते हैं। Lumen Finance की तरफ से कभी भी call पर OTP, PIN या card number नहीं माँगा जाता। क्या मैं link भेज दूँ?
समझ गया, धन्यवाद। एक बात और बताइए — link SMS आएगा या WhatsApp पर?
आपकी पसंद के हिसाब से भेज दूँगी, SMS या WhatsApp, जो भी आपको ठीक लगे। कौन सा चुनूँ?
SMS भेज दीजिए, वो ज़्यादा safe लगता है। मैं परसों की due date से पहले payment कर दूँगा, धन्यवाद।
ठीक है, मैं link भेज रही हूँ। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on the day after tomorrow. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

result.policy: The secure link works with UPI, debit card and net banking. Credit cards and cash are not accepted. Nobody from Lumen Finance will ask for an OTP, PIN, password or card number on a call.
result.message: Answer only what they asked, in one or two short sentences, from this text. Never add an amount, date or rule that is not in it.

args.notes: Borrower confirmed they will pay before the due date (परसों). Requested payment link via SMS, which was sent.
